Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner drew a premature conclusion that the places are not in the same country by conflating the Russian “Pleshkovo” with the Polish “Pleszkowo.” Instead of disambiguating the intended Pleshkovo (which, given the spelling and common usage, refers to Russian localities), the Planner assumed that the mere existence of similarly named places in different countries proves they are not in the same country. This reflects a failure to resolve ambiguity and to correctly synthesize the search results, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
